Commentary.Commentary: Phew! A triple ton, a five-for, a Pakistan collapse, an 8-fer and 346 almost being chased. One can safely say the first ever D/N Test in Asia has been nothing short of entertaining. Been a brilliant game this for all of us. Hope you enjoyed our coverage. The second Test begins on October 21 in Abu Dhabi at 1130 IST. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Pakistan skipper, MISBAH-UL-HAQ  says he thinks this is the beauty of the game. Adds that the way his side is playing, they are keeping the interest in Test cricket alive. Credits Yasir Shah for the way he bowled and also the West Indies team for the way they batted in the second innings. Gives special mention to Darren Bravo for his superb batting display in both innings. States that you can't really blame the pitch only, that the pink ball is new and the day/night conditions are different so it can't be judged how it will affect the play and the players. Says the pitch played slowly in the first three days and then in the last two days, Yasir and others got something out of the track. Mentions that it's always good if they play cricket like this, especially for the youngsters as this type of game will help them develop for the future. Credits the West Indies for playing well and hopes that they can give them another tough contest in the 2nd Test. (On Younis Khan) He says he practiced hard and the kind of person he is, he will be 100 percent if he is playing, so it's good to have him back. Ends by thanking the crowd for their support, especially on the final day as it went real close.

West Indies skipper, JASON HOLDER says it was a wonderful fight from his boys but is disappointed they couldn't get the result they wanted. Gives credit to Pakistan for the way they played. Hails Bishoo's spell of 8 wickets and says he did really well. States there are lots of positives for them. He says that he just wanted his batsmen to get them off to a start but unfortunately Samuels got out as he was the main guy for them. Once again credits Pakistan for the way they played. (On Darren Bravo) Mentions that it is very heartwarming to see the way he played and thought he would hang in there to see them through, so is obviously disappointed to see that didn't happen. States that Yasir Shah was pretty dangerous bowling off the rough and looked threatening. Ends by saying that it was a good match.

Man of the Match, AZHAR ALI says he wants to thank the Almighty first off. Adds that the pink ball experience was different, that only playing in different conditions will you get a feel of it. (On his triple ton) States that he doesn't think of such milestones and just looks to play his natural game. (When asked about playing under pressure) Responds by saying that playing under pressure makes him push harder and it's the job of every professional to give it their all no matter what the situation. Ends by saying that he will try to perform his best for his team at any given time.

West Indies came back strongly in the game with Devendra Bishoo taking 8 for 49. Pakistan were bowled out for a paltry score of 123 setting West Indies a target of 346. On the final day, one expected Pakistan to win clinically but once again it was Bravo who led West Indies with a vigilant 116. Pakistan were pushed to the walls and it took a contribution from everyone to seal the game in the last hour. Holder remained stranded for a well fought 40 but could not stop Pakistan from taking a 1-0 lead in the 3-match series.

What a memorable Test this has been! Fair to say D/N Test has made a pretty good debut in Asia! Pakistan have won their 400th Test! They dominated the Test for the first three days, thanks to a brilliant triple ton from Azhar Ali. West Indies responded with a fine effort. Bravo scored 87 but could not stop Pakistan from taking a 222-run lead. Yasir Shah was the star of the first innings as he took 5/121. With the amount of bowling done, Pakistan did not enforce the follow-on despite the huge lead.

OUT! HEARTBREAK FOR THE WINDIES! At a stage it looked like they could win it, let alone get a draw. Shocking turn of events for the visiting side. Ecstasy all around for Pakistan though and it's primed on Misbah's face. Yasir Shah hugs Sarfraz as Holder hangs his head in disappointment. It's on the pads, Holder flicks it down towards short fine leg and both batsmen set off for a single. Babar Azam is the man there and he quickly fires a throw at Sarfraz who whips the bails off in a jiffy. The dive put in by Shannon Gabriel is of no use as he falls extremely short. PAKISTAN HAVE WON THIS MATCH BY 56 RUNS AND LEAD THE SERIES 1-0!
Full and around off, driven down towards mid off for nothing.
FOUR! Too far down the leg side and Jason makes him pay. Sweeps it fine down the leg side and sends it all the way.
Loops it up outside leg, hits Holder on the pads as he looks to sweep it away.
Similar ball, same shot offered.
Yasir continues from around the wicket and bowls a tossed up leg breaker around off, Holder prods forward and blocks it out.
Outside off, defended off the back foot by Shannon Gabriel.
Pitched around off and turning away, Gabriel is beaten as the ball goes past the outside edge.
Nawaz gives it some decent flight and tosses it up around off, it's pushed to the off side for nothing.
Tossed up and drifting in on middle and leg, kept out off the front foot and into the track.
Flat and once more around off, pushed to the off side for nothing.
Flatter one around off, some decent drift on that, it's blocked off the back foot to the off side.

FOUR! Turning towards the off stump from outside leg, Holder goes back and punches it to the right of mid on. Beats the man there and picks up a boundary. West Indies need 61 more runs to win this Test.
Comes from around the wicket now and tosses it up way outside leg, no problem for Holder to pad it away.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Yasir floats it up around off, Holder pushes it towards extra cover.
Looped up once again on off, defended back to the bowler.
Tossed up on off, defended off the front foot to the off side.
DRINKS BREAK!
Holder looks for the big shot but gets a leading edge down to long off for a single.
What? This one is pushed to mid on and they take a single. Wonder what went through Holder's mind there?
Flatter outside off, another play and a miss by Gabriel.
Flatter on off, Gabriel pushes it back down the wicket.
Once again Gabriel looks to play on the up but is beaten by a flat one outside off.
Holder has a word with Gabriel.
Gabriel is playing his shots! Floated outside off, Gabriel plays inside the line and is beaten.
Outside leg, turns towards off, Holder is beaten all ends up on his attempted heave.
Landed outside leg, turns away from Holder who is beaten as he gives himself too much room to play an attacking stroke.
Landed on the stumps, Holder heaves it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. One reckons there could be a lot more shots played now. 67 more needed for West Indies!
Flatter on middle, Holder comes forward and defends it.
Shannon Gabriel is the last man in for West Indies.

OUT! RUN OUT! Nerves have got the better of Cummins! Fuller outside off, Cummins defends it down the wicket. He is late to call Holder through for a quick single. Misbah comes in from mid on, collects the ball and runs to the non-striker's end to take the bails off. That was a moment of harakiri from Cummins. Pakistan just a wicket away now.
Touch shorter on off, well kept out by Cummins.
Bowls it on off, turns away, Holder plays all across it and is beaten. The keeper puts up an appeal more to distract the batsman it seems.
This one is bowled on leg, Holder comes forward and blocks it.
Floated on middle, Holder defends it with his bat and pad together.
Landed outside off, turns away and keeps low too. Holder looks to play at that one but is beaten.
A touch flatter outside off, Holder defends it off his back foot.
Tossed up outside off, Cummins edges his push behind point for a single. Holder is happy and that is what he would have wished for.
Holder grunts as he fails to put this ball into the gap to farm the strike. It was a flatter one on the stumps, Holder went back to play that one but mistimed it back down the wicket.
Shortish outside leg, Holder looks to work it through the on side but fails to connect.
Holder comes forward and blocks this one.
Tossed outside leg, turning towards off, Holder looks to defend but does so with an outside edge.
Flatter on off, Holder defends it off his crease.
Shorter outside off, Holder punches it back down the wicket.
Floated on middle, Cummins defends it with an inside edge towards fine leg. He wanted the single but is sent back by Holder.
Miguel Cummins is the next man in.

OUT! NAWAZ STRIKES! Loopy and pitched on a length, turning in heavily from outside off, Bishoo stands back in his crease to play that one but the ball raps him on the pads. The players appeal and the finger goes up. Pakistan celebrate the wicket. Bishoo has a chat with Holder. He first looks to go away without a review then thinks of taking it. The umpire informs him it is too late to take the review. He has to walk back. Pakistan two wickets away, West Indies 70 runs away.
Sohail Khan is warming up.
EDGED! Floated outside off, Bishoo edges it down to third man for a couple of runs. Holder was hesitant in taking the second one.
Leg slip in place now along with short leg. The field has come up with Bishoo on strike.
Full toss on the pads, worked away to backward square for a single.
Fuller on middle, Holder defends it back to the bowler.
Shorter outside off, keeps low, played to covers by Holder.
Goes over the wicket, bowls this around off, Bishoo looks to play at it but is beaten.
Flatter on off, Bishoo defends it back down the wicket.
Landed outside off, comes in, Bishoo tucks it to short fine leg.
Turns this one from outside off, Bishoo fails to work it through mid-wicket but is hit on his pads.
Bishoo drives this one towards mid off from his crease.
Floated outside off, Bishoo defends it off his back foot.
A touch shorter on off, keeps low, Holder plays it back down the wicket.
Flatter on middle, Bishoo defends it off the inside edge to fine leg for a single.
Shortish outside off, played down to long off for a run.
Shorter on middle, goes away, Holder stands back and punches it back.
Holder comes forward and defends this one.
Fuller outside leg, played back to the bowler by Holder.
Nawaz called back to have a go with the ball.
Extremely full and loopy outside off, Bishoo drives it straight to the man at cover.
Flighted on the stump, Jason Holder clears his front leg and drives it down to long off for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shorter and flatter, turning heavily, Holder goes back and defends.
Loops it up outside leg once more, Holder looks to pad it away but the ball goes round his legs and off the keeper's pads.
Continues from around the wicket, tosses it up outside leg, goes off the inside edge past short leg.
Good length delivery outside off, Devendra Bishoo raises his bat skywards and lets it go past him.
Angling in on middle and leg, worked to the on side with soft hands.
Back of a length delivery on off, angling in sharply, goes off the outer half of the bat on the off side as Bishoo looks to block it off the back foot.
Length ball just around off, Holder opens the face of the bat and dabs it towards point for a single.
Fires it full and very, very wide outside off, no way Jason Holder is going to have anything to do with that.
Wahab with a length delivery angling across the right-hander, it's kept out off the back foot on the off side.
Bishoo presses forward to this fullish delivery and blocks it out.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Four Byes! Floated outside off, it doesn't turn and beats the outside edge of Bishoo's bat. Goes off Sarfraz's pad as well and races away behind for a boundary. Free runs for the visitors here.
Yasir flights this one up nicely and pitches it just back of a driving length, around off, shoots off the surface a bit and hits Devendra on the body.
Looped up leg breaker outside off, Bishoo lunges across and pushes it to covers.
Tossed up outside leg from around the wicket, Holder works it through square leg and takes a single.
Back of a length on off, Bishoo defends it off his crease.
Full outside off, Holder squeezes it past point for a single.
Good length outside off, an easy leave for Holder.
Holder defends this off his crease.
Fuller outside off, left alone.
Good length outside off, Holder plays it to point.
Devendra Bishoo walks in to bat.

OUT! YASIR THE MESSIAH FOR PAKISTAN! Floated outside off, Bravo looks to drive it through mid on. The bat turns his hands and the ball flies back to Yasir who leaps to his left to grab that out of thin air. What a catch that, took a moment of brilliance to dismiss Bravo and boy, isn't Yasir happy? Has Yasir turned the game around for his side here? Pakistan need 3 more wickets to win. Poor Bravo is distraught. He played out of his skin till this moment. Still 26 overs to go, West Indies need 83 more runs to win.
Another one down the leg side, nudged through the on side for a single.
TURN! Flatter outside leg, spins away, Holder is beaten all ends up.

NOT OUT! Reviews exhausted by Pakistan! Yasir bowls this one outside leg, turning away towards off, Holder comes forward to defend but seems to have missed it. The first slip fielder takes the catch and appeals. The umpire is unmoved though. Pakistan are desperate for a wicket and that results in a review from Misbah. Replays confirm it was not out. They even check for an lbw, just for the record.
Pakistan have taken a review against Holder.
This one is kept out by Holder.
Holder defends this one off his back foot.
DRINKS BREAK!
Good length outside off, Holder plays this towards covers for a single and keeps the strike. 27 overs, 84 runs, 4 wickets!
Shorter length outside off, left alone by Holder.
Holder drives this one towards mid off.
On a length on off, Holder defends it.
Second slip comes in now.
FOUR! EDGED! Fuller outside off, Holder goes for the drive away from his body without any footwork. The ball flies past first slip for a boundary.
Length ball on middle, tucked towards the on side.
Bowls it too full on middle, kept out by Bravo.
Tossed up outside off, played through covers for a single.
Bowls the leggie on off, Holder covers the spin and defends it.
Bowls this short on middle, Bravo goes back and pulls it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Landed around off, Bravo pushes it to the off side off the outer half. That did keep a touch low.
Floated on off, Bravo comes forward and defends it back.
Yasir Shah returns for a bowl.
Fuller outside off, Holder pushes it down the wicket.
No ball! Riaz putting in the extra effort oversteps this time. Bowls a short one down the leg side, Holder gets out of the way and lets it through.
Angled in a length on off, Holder plays it back to the bowler.
Fuller on off, Holder leans forward and keeps it out.
Good length outside off, Holder defends it towards covers off his crease.
Cutter from Riaz outside off, Holder hangs his bat at it but cannot put bat to ball.
On a good length on off, Holder pushes it towards covers.
Wahab Riaz comes back on for a spell.
NOT IN CONTROL! Cutter from Amir, Bravo once again is early into his drive and ends up chipping it over the bowler's head for a couple of runs down the ground.
On a length outside off, Holder dabs it down to third man for a single.
Full on the stumps, Bravo clips it late and it goes off the inner half past short leg. That went past the fielder close-in for a single.
Bouncer! Shorter outside off, Bravo is happy to let it go through.
The short ball comes but it is not quite that sharp and is pulled through mid-wicket for a couple.
Azhar Ali comes under the helmet at short leg.
Fuller in length on middle, Holder flicks it in the air towards square leg for a single.
Banged in short on middle and leg, Bravo lets it go through. 31 overs left, 99 runs to win.
Good length outside off, keeps a touch low, pushed into covers for a single.
Fuller length on off, Holder comes forward and defends it.
Dug in short on middle and leg, Holder just crouches a touch to let it go through.
Fuller outside off, Bravo crashes it through covers for a single.
On a length on off, Bravo plays it back down the wicket.
Good length delivery around off, solidly blocked towards cover-point to end the over.
Another length delivery which is angled in, Holder gets on top of the ball and leans forward to tap it in front of covers.
Comes around the wicket and bowls a length ball outside off, watchful leave from the Windies skipper.
The left-armer angles in a length delivery from outside off, DB easily runs this down to third man for one run.
Short one from Amir and that has surprised Bravo. He is unable to pick it up, takes his eyes off the ball as it goes off his glove on the off side.
Good length delivery on off stump, Darren Bravo stands firm and keeps it out on the off side.
Arrows it full and attacks the stumps, Jason Holder manages to bring his bat down in time to keep it out.
50-run stand up between Bravo and Holder! This has been a fine performance from these two. The visitors need them to carry on.
On a length and pitched on the pads, it's tucked to the on side for one run.
Fires this very full and very wide outside off, no way Darren Bravo is going to bother himself with that.
Length delivery straying on the pads, it's neatly clipped to fine leg for a run.
On a good length and outside off, it holds its line as Holder tries to defend it inside the line. Goes past the outside edge and into Sarfraz's gloves.
Length ball wide outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Over the wicket to Darren Bravo, he drives this full ball back down to Misbah at mid off. An eventful over from Mohammad Amir comes to an end.
Back of a length delivery angling in on the body, Holder walks across and tucks it down towards long leg for a single.

Not out! Amir continues from around the wicket and fires in a length ball which comes in heavily from around off, Jason Holder looks to play at it but misses and is rapped on the pads. A loud appeal for a leg before goes up but the umpire isn't interested. Pakistan however, disagree and decide to take a review. It goes upstairs and replays show that the ball was angling down and missing the leg stump. Jason Holder survives a scare.
Holder was caught on the pads but was given not out. Pakistan feel differently and decide to take a review against the decision.
Has a change of angle and comes from around the wicket, angles in a length ball from outside off, Holder lunges forward and lets it go past him.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Full and swinging in to the right-hander, it's driven towards Misbah at mid off.
Bumper to end the over. Darren Bravo once again awkwardly ducks and lets it go over him.
FOUR! Fuller and outside off, Bravo stands tall, picks the gap and crunches it through the covers. No need to run for that as the ball races away to the fence for a boundary.
Sohail Khan brings out the short one, Bravo very awkwardly manages to duck and let the ball sail over him.
Short of a length delivery angling in to the body, Holder pulls this away towards backward square leg. It's in the air, for a quite a while too, but falls safely as the batsmen take a single.

What are you doing going after that, Jason Holder? Just let that be. It's really, really wide outside off and the Windies skipper still goes after it. Dangerous as he could have just as easily nicked it.
Some extra bounce for Sohail Khan. He pounds in a short one around off, the ball rises a little too sharply on Holder as he tries to pull it away. Goes past the edge and into the keeper's gloves.
Length ball aiming the top of off stump, Darren Bravo stands his ground and keeps it out on the off side with utmost ease.
Fullish and outside off, driven straight to the man at covers.
Spears in a full ball and gets it to swing in, around off, Holder gets it off the inside half of the bat towards mid on for a run.
Slightly fuller in length and around off, swinging away, Bravo opens the face and taps it square on the off side for a single.
Leg bye! Full and swinging in on leg, it goes off Holder's pads as he looks to flick it away. A leg bye is taken and no shout for a leg before as the ball was sliding down leg.
Fires it full and well outside off, it's hit straight to the cover fielder.
MOHAMMAD AMIR will bowl from the other end.
Bangs in a short one to end the over. Darren Bravo sees it early and ducks quickly.
Full and swinging in from around off, Bravo drives it back down towards mid off.
On a length and angling in on the pads, it's clipped through square leg for a single.
Good length ball on off, Jason prods forward and defends it to the off side.
Full ball on off, Holder stands his ground and pushes it to mid on.

That was so, so close! Beautiful delivery to start things off with. Sohail Khan bowls it fuller outside off, it's well away as Holder looks to have a poke at it. The ball just beats the outside edge and goes into the keeper's gloves.

Welcome back for the final session of this Test! 114 runs, 4 wickets, 38 overs is the equation in front of us. One of those Tests were things have done down to the wire and all three results are possible. DARREN BRAVO AND JASON HOLDER are out to bat. Pakistan begin session with SOHAIL KHAN. Here we go....
....DAY 5...SESSION 3.....

Bravo continued his good form notching up his 8th Test ton, seven of them have come away from home which speaks volumes about his capability. He has got good support from Holder and will be hoping to bat in similar fashion and take West Indies to a memorable victory scoring the remaining 114 runs off the minimum 38 overs. Pakistan on the other hand, need 4 more wickets and they have a minimum of 38 overs to achieve that. It is going to be a thrilling final session. Do join us for all the action in some time.

A moving session of Test cricket this! Pakistan were kept at bay for a long time by the Chase-Bravo partnership. Yasir Shah broke the stand, dismissing Chase. Riaz then castled Dowrich first ball but that was all that went Pakistan's way in the session. They have toiled hard and the slowness of the pitch has not quite worked in their favour. They have the new ball to work with and will hope it works in their favour in the final session of this milestone Test for them.
Full and just around off, Darren Bravo brings his bat down to this and pushes it to the cover region. And with that, IT WILL BE SUPPER ON DAY 5!
Back of a length delivery outside off, kept out off the back foot on the off side.
Beautifully bowled! Excellent length delivery in the channel outside off, shaping away just a touch as Bravo looks to have a feel at it. Beats the outside edge and goes into Sarfraz's gloves.
Full once more, around off, it's driven down to mid off for no run.
Fullish in length and once again, it's swinging away, Darren Bravo lunges forward and watches as the ball goes past him.
Amir with some good shape on that. Fires it in full and gets it to swing away from Bravo. He raises his bat and leaves it alone.
Keeps it on the fuller side once more, just around the off stump, Holder answers it with a straight bat and keeps it out on the off side.
Full and swinging away outside off, Jason Holder raises his bat and lets it be.
Fuller on the pads, it's clipped through backward square leg for a single.
Excellent from Sohail Khan! Gets this length delivery around off to swing in, it's a tight line but Bravo does well to keep it out.
Length ball aiming the top of off stump, Holder gets an inside edge through backward square leg and takes a single for it.
Fullish in length and pitched outside off, getting some shape away from the right-hander, it's not played at. Easy take for the keeper.
SOHAIL KHAN called back on for a bowl with the second new ball.
On a good length and outside off, Darren Bravo has no trouble in leaving that one alone.
Full and swinging in from around off, Holder looks to push it away from his body but ends up getting an inside edge behind square leg. A run is taken.
Length ball outside off, Bravo opens the face of the bat and guides it down towards third man for a single.
Curving away from the left-hander on a fuller length, outside off, Darren doesn't have anything to do with that.
Fuller length delivery shaping away outside off, it's left alone for the keeper to collect.
8th Test Ton for Darren Bravo! And it's his 7th overseas. A marvelous feat.

FOUR! What a way to bring up your century! Very full and outside off, Darren Bravo leans into this and crashes it past point. Sends it all the way to the boundary line for a well-deserved ton. Amazing knock, has been brilliant under pressure here.
And to nobody's surprise, it will be MOHAMMAD AMIR to take the new ball first up.
The second new ball is available and taken immediately.
Holder once again comes forward and defends it.
Floated on middle, Holder comes forward and blocks it.
Floated outside off, Holder drives it through covers off his crease.
Flatter on the pads, Bravo works it down to fine leg for a single.
Bowled on middle, Bravo lunges forward and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, Bravo drives it to covers off his crease.
Short and flat around off, turning away from Jason Holder. He goes back in an attempt to whip it through mid-wicket but doesn't get any bat on it. It goes off Sarfraz' gloves as well.
Turning in on middle and leg, Darren stays back and tucks it towards fine leg for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Shortish and going down leg, Bravo goes for the big pull but misses it completely.
Similar delivery, same shot offered.
Loopy and turning in from a length on middle and leg, Bravo goes back and defends it back down the track.
Short and flat outside off, Jason Holder walks across and taps it to the off side.
The West Indies skipper once again presents a solid front foot defense.
Full and drifting in on middle and leg, Holder takes a big stride forward to defend.
Too full and on the stumps, no trouble for Bravo as he just drives this down to long on for a single.
Nawaz floats this one up nicely on middle and off, Darren stays deep within his crease and keeps it out with a straight bat.
Tossed up on off stump, blocked.
Easy single for West Indies as Darren Bravo punches this down to long off off the back foot for one run. That's the end of the over.
Jason Holder gets to the pitch of the delivery and hits it down to long off for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
It's in the air once more but it's hit too hard. Full and outside off, Holder uppishly drives it past the diving short cover fielder. Gets a single for doing so.
So close. A very brave leave by Jason Holder. Flatter one just outside off, Holder lunges forward and shoulders his arms to it. The ball just whiskers past the off stump.

IN THE AIR... BUT IT'S SAFE! That was in the air for a long time but nobody came under it. Tossed up around off, Bravo looks to big down the ground but doesn't get a hold of this at all. It skies straight back down the ground but falls exactly between the long on and long off fielder. A single is taken.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flat and aimed at off stump, punched off the back foot to the left of the bowler.
Flatter and drifting in, Jason gets behind the line and blocks.
Tossed up around off, it's pushed to covers for no run.
Full on middle and leg, Jason Holder clears his front leg and drives it towards wide mid on.
Shorter and flatter on the stumps, Darren goes back and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
MOHAMMAD NAWAZ is back on.
Tossed up outside off, pushed to point for nothing.
Looped up around off, Holder offers a tight front foot block.
The batsman has swept that one through the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Loopy and fullish in length outside off, it's driven to mid off for nothing.
Shorter in length and outside off, it's punched down to long off for a single.

Continues from around the wicket and tosses it outside off, Bravo lunges across and pushes it past the vacant silly point position. He sets off for a single as Sarfraz charges to the ball. Tumbles but as he does, fires in a throw at the striker's end. There isn't anybody close to the stumps at that point otherwise it would have been really close. A single is completed.
Fuller in length outside off, Holder leans ahead, brings his bat down to it and blocks.

Slower short of a length delivery outside off, Bravo waits for this for a good while before slapping it through towards sweeper cover. Azhar Ali is the man out in the deep and he does exceptionally well. Runs to his left and puts in a good dive to keep the ball from the ropes. Saves a vital run for his side as he keeps the batsmen down to three.
Some chin music for the batsman as Wahab bangs it in short, it's ducked and evaded.

FOUR! Oooh... Bisected the two perfectly there, even if he didn't mean to. Full toss on the pads, Bravo just helps this fine down the leg side. Pierces the gap between leg slip and the keeper, even as both dived and sends it all the way.
A leg slip in place and a man out in the deep on the leg side for the hook...
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Length ball angling in from outside off, defended from within the crease.

Not out! Guess the hosts took the review since the reviews will be reinstated after 7 overs. They still have a review left, despite this one being wasted. Yasir Shah tosses it up just outside off, Bravo looks to drive this back down the ground but the ball goes just past the outside edge. There's a huge appeal for a caught behind but the umpire isn't interested. Misbah decides to take a review against the decision and it goes upstairs. Replays show that the sound came from the bat hitting the ground and not the ball. The southpaw survives.
A review for a caught behind appeal is taken against Darren Bravo.
Turning in from outside off, loopy as well, Darren goes back and works it to the on side.

FOUR! Two in two for Darren Bravo and Misbah-ul-Haq is furious. Once again it's extremely full from Yasir Shah, outside off, Bravo strides forward and drills it hard through the cover region for a boundary. Sohail Khan is the man out in the deep and he reacts late, adding to his skipper's fury.

FOUR! Brings the 200 up in style. Too full from the leggie, it's well outside off as Darren Bravo leans into the drive. He caresses it through the covers and sends it all the way to the boundary line.

Lovely tossed up leg-spinner outside off, pitched just back of a driving length and this is the length Yasir Shah should be bowling consistently. Bravo lunges out to defend but the ball goes off his pads.
A silly point seems to be coming in place now. Azhar Ali is getting his safety guards on, asked for a helmet as well.
Loopy and turning in from outside off, from around the wicket, Bravo goes behind and defends it back down the track.
Bouncer! Shorter in length outside off, Holder picks it early and is out of the way in time.
Bowls another cutter on off, Holder defends it well back down the wicket.
Fuller again outside off, squeezed behind point for a single.
Riaz attempts another yorker, ends up bowling a full toss outside off, Holder plays it through point for a single.
Jason Holder is the new man in for West Indies.

OUT! TIMBER! Riaz bowls another yorker and this time on middle, hint of reverse again. Dowrich is late to get his bat down in time and the ball crashes into the stumps. That was just too good and pacy from Riaz. He is happy, two in two overs for Pakistan and the game has moved on.
Riaz goes round the wicket.
Starts with a yorker on the stumps, a hint of reverse for Riaz. Bravo digs it out towards mid on for a single.
Shane Dowrich walks in to bat. Wahab Riaz and Misbah have a chat about the field.
DRINKS BREAK!

OUT! FINALLY A WICKET FOR YASIR! This one is bowled just outside leg, Chase looks to repeat the shot played on the previous delivery but this time he is not to the pitch of the ball. The ball turns away and hits timber. Yasir Shah is jubilant with the wicket. Misbah pumps his fist. It is a hard earned wicket for Yasir. Could this be the opening for Pakistan?
FOUR! Fetch that! Yasir bowls it too full outside leg,  Chase gets to the pitch of the ball and clips it hard through mid-wicket for a boundary. That was superbly done.
Bowls it outside leg, Chase pads it away.
Works it down the leg side for a single.
Slower one, spun in nicely from outside off, Bravo is hit on his body as he fails to defend.
Floated outside off, Bravo comes forward and defends it to covers.
Shorter outside off, easy leave for Chase. That was a cutter from Riaz.
Good length outside off, Chase defends it off his crease.
Fuller outside off, Bravo plays it to deep cover for a single.
The fuller one does but is directed way down the leg side. Poor execution from Riaz.
Shorter again on middle, Bravo ducks under it. When is the fuller ball coming from Riaz?
Shorter length outside off, left alone by Bravo.
Bravo calls for the helmet and that has held up play.
This one is punched down to long on for a single.
Bravo defends this one back down the wicket.
Tossed up outside off, Bravo lunges forward and defends it.
Fuller on off, Bravo gets across and plays it back to the bowler.
Bravo lunges forward and guides it down to third man off the outer half of the bat. A couple taken.
What happened there? Floated outside off, turns in a long way, Bravo looks to guide it down but misses.
Angles in a fuller length one on off, Chase defends it off his crease.
On a length outside off, Chase plays it towards point off his crease.
Goes over the wicket, bowls it full outside off, kept out by Chase.
Dabs this behind point for a single.
Goes over the wicket, Bravo drives it hard through point where Yasir puts in a fine dive to stop a certain boundary to his right.
Angled on a good length on middle, worked behind square leg for a single.
Shorter again outside off, comes in, Bravo punches it back down the wicket.
Floated on off, Bravo comes forward and blocks it.
Chase works this one of his hips for a single.
This one is spinning down leg, Bravo works it with the angle down to fine leg for a single.
Floated on off, Bravo comes forward and defends it.

FOUR! Nicely done! Shorter outside off, turns in a long way, Bravo though is watching it like a hawk, he arches back and cuts it through backward point for a boundary. That was superbly played by Bravo.
Yasir comes back on. He has changed ends again.
Bouncer! Shorter ball on middle and leg but it is far too short for Chase who sits underneath it easily. The keeper has to jump to connect it.
Hurls it outside off, Chase drives it at it loosely with no footwork. That was a cutter from Riaz.
Fuller on the stumps, Chase keeps it out.
Goes around the wicket, angles it on a length outside off, comes in with the angle but pitches and goes away. Chase looks to play at it from his crease but is beaten.
On a length outside off, Chase keeps it out.
Good length outside off, Bravo gets it down to third man for a single. That was more of an edge.
Misbah brings back Wahab for a spell. Pakistan need him to bowl one of his crazy spell of taking wickets in a flurry!
Bravo clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Mickey Arthur looks tensed in the Pakistan dressing room.
Fuller outside off, Bravo comes forward and blocks it.
Fuller on off, Bravo clips it through mid-wicket for a brace. Shouldn't be long before Pakistan start to get a bit desperate for wickets.
On a length on off, Bravo comes forward and pushes it to the off side.
Angled on a good length on middle, Chase nudges it to square leg for a single.
Shorter in length outside off, left alone by Chase.
Punched off the back foot by Bravo. No runs taken.
Comes forward and keeps this one out.
Goes around the wicket, bowls it outside leg, Chase nudges it down to fine leg for a single.
Bravo pushes it to covers for a single off his crease.
Turns this one from outside off, Bravo looks to clip but misses.
Floated outside off, turns in, Bravo comes forward and blocks it.
Good length outside off, Chase dabs it down to third man. They look for the second and that puts pressure on Sohail coming in from third man and he misfields. A second is taken.
Good length outside off, Bravo stands tall and punches it past the diving cover fielder for a single.
On a length outside off, Bravo opens the face of the bat and pushes it towards point. He looks for a single but is sent back.
50-run stand between Bravo and Chase!
Fuller outside off, Chase plays at it from his crease and gets it towards square leg off the inside edge for a single.
On a length on off, Chase covers the line well and defends it.
Goes round the wicket, bowls it fuller on off, keeps a tad low, Chase does well to keep that one out.
Turns this one from off, Bravo keeps it down and turns it towards leg slip.
Floated outside off, Bravo defends it with his bat and pad together. The ball dies down in front of short leg.
Spins one from outside off, Bravo goes back and punches it to covers.
Another forward defense from Bravo to this fuller one.
Floated on off, Bravo comes forward and defends it.
Too full on the pads, Chase top edges his sweep through square leg for a single.
FOUR! GLORIOUS! On a length outside off, Bravo just stands in his crease and caresses it through covers off his back foot. The ball just raced away to the fence. That was artistic from Bravo.

OUCH! Shorter length outside off, Bravo looks to leave it but the ball deflects towards the keeper. The players go up in an apppeal but the umpire says no. A review is contemplated but not taken. The replays show that it came of Bravo's left arm.
A touch fuller on off, Bravo stays in his crease and defends it to covers.
Good length outside off, Bravo plays it towards point off his crease.
Bowls it on a length on off, Bravo stands in his crease and defends it back down the wicket.
Fuller outside off, Bravo drives it to mid off but does not find the gap.
Once again the man at silly point is hit. Azhar Ali is the man, and he's hit on the shin of the same leg. Ouch! That front foot drive from Roston Chase was hit pretty hard.
Yasir pushes this quicker through the air and aims the off stump, it's solidly blocked.
Turn and bounce for Yasir Shah as he loops this one up outside off, the right-hander has nothing to do with that.
Tossed up from over the wicket, outside off, Chase lunges forward and drives it hard. It hits the shin of the man at silly point. Must have stung, that.
17th Test fifty for Darren Bravo!
Tossed up delivery swerving in on middle and off, Bravo uppishly drives this down towards long on and takes a single. Brings up his fifty with that and it's been a superb knock under pressure so far.
Looped up from around the wicket, it's turned to mid-wicket. No run taken.
Good length ball angling in heavily from outside off, Chase stays behind the line and defends it to the off side.
Full and outside off, Chase takes a big stride forward and drives it towards covers right off the middle of the bat. It's straight to the fielder, though. Unfortunate for Roston.
Amir bowls this just ahead of a length, around the off stump line, Roston Chase is pretty solid in his defense.
Comes running in from wide of the crease here and sharply angles in a fuller length delivery on the stumps, Chase brings his bat in front of his pads and keeps it out solidly.
Pitches it right up there, just outside off, it's driven back down towards mid off.
Comes around the wicket to Roston Chase, bowls a back of a length delivery which is angling in from outside off, it's tapped away in front of cover-point for nothing.
MOHAMMAD AMIR will bowl from the other end. Has a slip in place...
Punched through covers for a couple of runs.
Floated outside off, turns in, Bravo looks to clip but misses. The ball goes off the pads and dies down to short leg.
Floated on middle, Chase defends it with an inside edge towards square leg.
Shorter outside off, pushed to covers by Chase.
Shorter on off, comes in, Bravo works it to fine leg for a single.
The ball has been changed in the break, informs Ian Bishop on air.
Floated outside off, Chase drives it to sweeper cover for a single.

Welcome back for the second session of play. The players are back out in the middle. Darren Bravo and Roston Chase are out to continue batting. Pakistan begin the second session with Yasir Shah. Here we go...
...DAY 5....SESSION 2...

West Indies still need 192 more runs to win. While the visitors will need something special to win this from here, they will back themselves to play out the overs to earn a draw. The pitch has held up well so far and Pakistan will want it to break a bit more to get more help for their bowlers. They have been disciplined but have not troubled the batsmen. Both teams have a lot of work to do. It sets up a fascinating evening for all of us. Do join us in a short while for the second session of play.

A decent session of Test cricket! Both Pakistan and West Indies have had their moments in the session. Pakistan struck with the first ball of the day when Amir dismissed Samuels but Bravo has held fort from the other end. He got good support from Blackwood before a good review from Nawaz broke the stand. Since then, Bravo and Chase have been solid in defense and have also put the bad balls away.
Length delivery on the pads, it's tucked behind square on the leg side for an easy single. That will be TEA ON DAY 5!
Length ball aiming the top of off stump, Darren Bravo guides it down to third man for one run.
Pitched just ahead of a length and it's well outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Fullish and just outside off, it's played to point for no run.
Off cutter on a fuller length around off, Bravo prods forward to defend.
Back of a length delivery angled across, kept out off the back foot.
From around the wicket, it's turning in sharply into Darren Bravo. He does very well to get back and tuck it down towards long leg for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the backfoot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Turning away on a length and from around off, Chase goes back and steers it towards backward point with an angled bat.
Looped up and pitched just around off, defended off the front foot and into the track ahead.
Shortish in length and outside off, punched away to the off side.
Flat and short outside off, Chase goes back and looks to cut it away. Ends up getting a bottom edge onto the track though as the ball falls right beside the batsman.
YASIR SHAH is back on to bowl now. He has a short leg and a slip in place.
Shortish and angling in on the body, it's pulled down to fine leg for an easy run. That will be the end of the over.
Short of a length delivery on the body, Bravo pulls this away through backward square leg and takes a single as the fielder from fine leg comes running in to cut it off.
On a length and shaping across Darren Bravo, he stands his ground and keeps it out confidently.
Back of a length and tailing in on middle and leg, Chase off his back foot works it through mid-wicket for a single.
A hint of reverse swing there for Sohail Khan. He spears in a fuller ball around off, it's coming back in as Roston Chase answers it by bringing down a solid, straight bat.
Length delivery just outside off, Chase stays behind the line and blocks.
Beautiful stuff to end the over. Wahab fires in an accurate yorker on middle and off, 140 kph, Darren Bravo is up for this and does well to bring his bat down in time to squeeze it out.
Another short one from Wahab, it's ducked and evaded rather comfortably.
Sharp bumper on middle and off, Bravo just about manages to duck under it in time.
Another back of a length delivery which is pitched outside off, Darren opens the face and dabs it to the fielder at point.
Low full toss going down leg, Bravo looks to flick but misses.

FOUR! He's a sweet timer of the ball, isn't he? Back of a length delivery outside off, Bravo goes back and punches it through cover-point. There are fielders chasing it down but the ball wins the race. Reaches the rope before the fielders as the umpire signals a boundary.
Good ball! Hurls in a yorker at 139 kph on the stumps, Chase is watching it like a hawk though and digs it out in time.
Chase defends this one back down the wicket.
Goes wide of the crease and bowls a good length ball on off, goes away a touch, Chase defends it well from within his crease.
Fuller but angling on the pads, Bravo clips it to square leg for a single.
Similar length outside off, Bravo stays in his crease and pushes it to point.
Begins with a good length ball on off, Bravo defends it from his crease.
Sohail Khan comes on for a bowl.
Solid stuff from Roston Chase as he shuffles across to this length delivery outside off and blocks it with a straight bat.
Pitched slightly ahead of a length, still outside off, Roston leans forward and blocks it out.
Good length outside off, Chase has nothing to do with this one. Lets it through for the keeper to collect.
Another fuller length ball which is angling in from outside off, Roston Chase gets right behind the line and blocks it out.
Full and angling in, outside off, Chase gets his bat down to this one and punches it towards the point region.
Leg bye! Length ball angling in, goes off Bravo's thigh pad as he attempts to flick it away. It runs down towards fine leg as a leg bye is taken.
From around the wicket to Chase, it's on the shorter side as it's kept out off the back foot.
Full and on the stumps, it's driven back down to long on for a run.
Loopy and turning in on middle and off, Bravo gets back to this one and turns it past short leg once more. Another dot ball.
Short and turning in on middle and leg, Darren goes back and dabs it past short leg.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up around off, Chase takes a big stride forward and drives it down to long off for a single.
Back of a length outside off, that's blocked solidly once more. End of the over.
A length ball which is angling in from outside off, kept out from within the crease to the off side.
No ball! Length ball on the pads, it's nudged down to fine leg for one. Umpire signals a no ball as the pacer has overstepped his line.
Lovely delivery! Pitches this up one outside off, it's straightens up a shade as Chase is all squared up. There isn't much foot movement as the ball beats the outside edge.
Length ball outside off, defended off the back foot to the off side.
Wahab Riaz has a change of angle, comes from around the wicket and immediately bangs in a short one, it's angling in and goes just past the helmet.

FOUR! Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, Roston Chase goes back, swivels across and pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary. Got himself into position quickly and played it with so much ease. Lovely shot.

FOUR! Easy pickings. It's flat and turning in, then angling down the leg side. Bravo goes back and just helps it on its way. Beats the chasing short fine leg fielder as the ball races away to the boundary line.
Nawaz floats it up well just outside off, Darren Bravo drives it to covers for nothing.
Over the wicket to Bravo, it's flat and on the stumps, the left-hander clips it past short leg. Won't get any run for it, though.
Full on middle and leg, it's eased down to long on for an easy single.
Another solid from foot defense presented by the batsman.
From wide of the crease, Nawaz tosses it on middle and leg, it's drifting in as Chase presses ahead and smothers the spin.
Wide outside off, on a back of a length and it's going to do no harm to the batsman. It's left alone as Sarfraz collects it behind the stumps.
Back of a length delivery outside off, not much movement here, Darren Bravo stays behind and punches it in front of covers for no run.
Wahab brings out the short one and pounds it in on middle and off, Bravo picks it up early and does well to duck.
On a good length once more, just outside off, Bravo stays deep within his crease and keeps it out.
Bowls another length ball across, it's outside off, Roston Chase looks to play at this with an angled bat but gets an edge down towards third man for a single.
Wahab starts off with a length ball, angles it across the right-hander, it's tapped away in front of covers off the back foot.
Wahab Riaz to bowl now. He looks to be in some pain, holding his right side. He did go off the field yesterday but he seems fit enough to bowl for now.
Pitched around off, just back of a driving length, Darren punches it off the back foot to end the over.
Loopy and full on off stump, it's eased down to mid on for a single.
Flighted well by Nawaz, on middle and off, kept out off the front foot and into the track.
Fuller and attacking the stumps, Chase gets behind the line and keeps it out with a straight bat.

FOUR! That's a beautiful shot. All about the timing, that. It's floated well around off, Roston Chase leans forward, gets big over the ball and with the use of his wrists, flicks it through the mid-wicket region to pick up a boundary.
Loopy and on a length around off, it's punched off the back foot to cover-point.

Fullish in length from the leggie, Roston Chase gets to the pitch of the delivery and works it to the right of mid on. The placement on that is beautiful and that will earn him three runs as the fielder chases it down.
Lovely flight on that from Yasir Shah, he tosses it up well on middle and off, some nice drift on that, Roston does well to prod forward and block.
From the other side of the stumps now, it's tossed up just around off, Chase defends it off his front foot.
Change of angle again, it's looped up outside off, Bravo drives it through to deep cover for a run.
Comes from over the wicket to Chase and fires it in very full on the pads, it's dipping in as it's worked behind square on the leg side for one run.
Continues from around the wicket, gets it to spin in from outside off, the southpaw tucks this to fine leg for a single.
DRINKS BREAK!
Bowls this shorter outside off, Chase goes back to whip it through mid on but finds the fielder.
Tossed up on off, Chase comes forward and defends it riding the extra bounce on that one.
Landed outside off, spins away, left alone by Chase.
Floated outside off, Chase comes forward and blocks it.
Similar length on middle, Chase works it towards mid-wicket off his crease.
Floated outside off, holds its line, Chase looks to push it to covers but is beaten all ends up.
Fuller outside off, Bravo comes forward and drives it to covers.

Shorter and spinning down, Bravo looks to clip it but does not succeed. The keeper collects and the players appeal. They think of a review but do not take it. There was no bat involved and the replays confirm the same.
Fuller outside off, Bravo clips it towards mid-wicket coming slightly forward.
Tossed up outside off, comes in, Bravo defends it nicely.
Bravo comes forward and pushes it into covers.
Floated outside off, comes in, Bravo looks to sweep but gloves it down to leg slip.
Bowls this on middle, Chase comes right forward and blocks it.
Floated on off, Chase drives it to covers off his crease.
Roston Chase is the new man in. Two slips in place for Nawaz.

OUT! WHAT A REVIEW! Arm ball from Nawaz on middle, Blackwood looks to work it through mid-wicket but is hit on his pads. The ball hits him on the flap on the front pad. The players appeal but the umpire is not interested. Nawaz has convinced Misbah to go for the review and they opt for it. There was no bat involved there so the only question is if it is hitting the stumps. Replays show it was hitting the stumps and that is great review from Nawaz and Blackwood has to go back. Pakistan need 6 more wickets to win this game.
Pakistan have opted for a review against Blackwood who is not given out lbw.
What happened there? Floated on the pads, spins in late, Blackwood overbalances and falls over. No harm done though.
Floated on off, Blackwood drives it back to the bowler.
Blackwood hands over his helmet to the 12th man.
Shorter on middle, Blackwood tucks it to square leg for a couple of runs as the fielder is a touch slow to come in from the deep.
Floated outside off, turns in, Bravo watches it closely and turns it towards the on side.
Fuller outside off, Blackwood drives it through mid off for a single.
Flatter on middle, worked to short fine leg for a single.
Short outside off, turning away, punched through covers for a single.
Floated outside off, turns away, an easy leave for Blackwood.
Starts with a full toss on middle, Blackwood plays behind square on the leg side for a couple.
Change of ends for Yasir Shah!
Fuller outside off, Bravo comes forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Bravo comes forward and defends this one back.
Another back foot defense from Bravo back to the bowler.
Flatter one on off, Bravo goes back and defends it back to the bowler.
This one is bowled on off and middle, Bravo taps it just short of the short leg fielder.
Floated outside off, turns in, Bravo defends it from his crease.
Mohammad Nawaz into the attack.
On a length on off and middle, Blackwood plays it towards mid on. Blackwood looks for a single but is not on and is sent back in time.
Fuller outside off, Blackwood taps it towards covers off his crease.
Bravo taps this length ball to covers and calls Blackwood through for a quick single.
Another bouncer from Amir, Bravo ducks under it in time to let it go through.
Bouncer! Shorter in length on off and middle, Bravo ducks underneath it.
On a length outside off, Bravo plays it to point off his back foot.
This one is bowled on leg, turns in, Blackwood comes a touch forward and taps it toward short leg.
Floated on off, turns away, a good leave by Blackwood.
A touch short outside off, Bravo looks to defend but gets it off the outer half of the bat past first slip for a single.
Floated on off, turned towards mid-wicket.
Too full again on middle, played to mid on by Blackwood for a run. A poor throw ensures no harm is done.
Slow and loopy on off, Bravo pushes it towards covers for a single.
OH! Keeps it full and this is a touch wide though. Blackwood wants to play at it and is beaten all ends up. Nicely bowled that. This has been a good spell by Amir so far.
Slants it fuller outside off, Blackwood comes forward and drives it nicely to extra cover.
Fuller outside off, Blackwood pushes it back to the bowler.
On a length outside off, pushed into covers by Blackwood.
Good length outside off, Blackwood taps it towards short mid-wicket.
Dug in short but way outside off, picked early by Blackwood and left alone.
Landed on middle, Bravo looks to work it fine but finds the fielder at leg slip.
Nicely looped on off, turns in, Bravo looks to clip but ends up defending it back.
Shorter outside off, comes in, Bravo stands tall and punches it back to the bowler.
Cuts this one through covers for a single.
Landed on middle, spins down the leg side, Bravo fails to sweep that one. The ball goes past the keeper for a bye.
Floated outside off, comes in, Bravo defends it back down the wicket.
Fuller outside off, Blackwood drives it sweetly but to the fielder at covers.
Good length on off, Blackwood defends it from his crease.
Blackwood comes forward and pushes it to covers off his front foot.
Pitched up outside off, Blackwood strides forward and pushes it towards covers.
EDGED! On a length outside off, Blackwood looks to work it through mid-wicket off his crease but gets an inside edge onto  his pads.
Fuller outside off, Blackwood comes forward and pushes it to silly mid off.
Floated on off, comes in a touch, Bravo looks to clip it but fails to put bat to ball. The ball goes down as the leg slip fielder dives to stop the ball. Stifled appeal turned down.
Floated outside off, Blackwood drives it through mid off for a single.
Nicely looped but too full on middle, played back to the bowler.
Landed outside off, pushes to covers by Blackwood.
Blackwood comes forward and pushes it towards the off side.
Floated on middle, Blackwood defends it towards the mid-wicket region.
Catch that! Bowls the cutter on the stumps, Blackwood is early into his push and ends up pushing it over the head of the bowler. Shouts of catch it but there was no one there. A run taken.
FOUR! Nicely done! Fuller outside off, Blackwood stands his crease and crashes it through covers for a boundary. Superbly timed!
Outside off, pushed towards point off the crease by Blackwood.
Slants it on a length outside off, keeps a touch low, Bravo tucks it down to fine leg for a single.
Angled on a length on off, Bravo gets across and defends it.
Keeps this one out does Bravo from his crease.
Blackwood comes forward and keeps this one back.
Shorter on off, Blackwood stays back and defends it back to the bowler.
Bowls it on off and middle, Blackwood comes forward and blocks it.
Nicely tossed up outside off, Blackwood lets it go through safely.
Loopy on middle, Blackwood comes forward and works it towards mid-wicket.
Starts with a fuller one on the stumps, Blackwood pushes it towards point.
No surprise, Yasir Shah to bowl from the other end.
On a length on off, Bravo defends it back from his crease.
Fuller outside off, on 124 kph, keeps a touch low, left alone by Bravo.
Good length outside off, Bravo gets in line and defends it.
Dug in short on off, Blackwood tucks it towards square leg for a single to get off the mark.
Angled fuller on off, Blackwood defends it from his crease.
Jermaine Blackwood is the new man in.

OUT! What a start for Amir! Bowls it from around the wicket, keeps it full outside off, holds its line. Samuels just hangs his bat at it. The ball takes the outside edge and the ball goes through to the keeper Sarfraz for a simple catch. Perfect start for Pakistan, there just could not have been a better start for the hosts!
Time for the game! Darren Bravo and Marlon Samuels stride out to bat for West Indies. 251 runs, 8 wickets, 90 overs to go. Mohammad Amir has the ball in his hands. Let's begin!
PITCH REPORT - Bazid Khan doing the pitch report reckons that there are footmarks for the spinners to make use of. The wicket is dry and rough, the batsmen will have their task cut out.

West Indies need 251 more runs, Pakistan need 8 wickets. Pakistan will bank on spin especially Yasir Shah to take the remaining wickets. How long will West Indies fight? Will Yasir Shah spin a web around the visitors? Or will West Indies go on to create history with a memorable chase? Plenty of questions which would make this final day an exciting one, one presumes.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of the fifth and final day of the first ever D/N Test in Asia, between Pakistan and West Indies in Dubai. Pakistan were in control of the game for the first three days before capitulating like only they can to get bowled out for a paltry 123 yesterday. Their 222-run lead in the first innings actually helped them remain in the stronger position despite the collapse. Devendra Bishooo was the destroyer-in-chief for West Indies with his personal best of 8 for 49. West Indies chasing 346, have so far begun well with Darren Bravo leading from the front again.
....DAY 5...SESSION 1....

Day 5. 90 overs. 8 wickets in hand. 251 to win. Spinning track and a dusty surface. Pakistan hold the aces but if the Windies apply themselves as they did in the first innings, we could have a game on tomorrow. Will we see a cliffhanger? Join us at 1700 IST (1130 GMT) for all the action from the final day's play. Until then, Adios! Take Care!

Pakistan tried hard but the bowlers were a bit off colour. The dew was not helping them either but Amir and Yasir bowled really well and the former got a couple of wickets but could not quite get wickets continuously. The pitch is starting to break up and it will be a difficult task for the Windies tomorrow.

It took just 5 balls for Bishoo to wrap the Pakistan innings after Supper and then, the Windies openers got stuck to try and play normally. Brathwaite departed early but Johnson resisted and had a 60-run stand with Bravo for the second wicket before being dismissed at the close. Samuels has joined Bravo in the middle and the Windies will hope that they provide a repeat of the first innings' heroics.

End of a riveting day's play. Devendra Bishoo's 8-fer has turned around the game big time. Pakistan were a bit complacent while batting in the second innings and that could cost them a Test match here.
Landed outside off, spinning in, Bravo stays back and defends. STUMPS ON DAY 4!
Full and around middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and on middle, punched towards short mid-wicket.
Landed around off, nicely kept out.
Full and around off, well defended.
Short and outside off, spinning in, punched through the covers for a couple.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
